title: VerificationPolicyV1
description: Content-addressed rules defining what verified means for a Spend Attestation. This candidate schema defines the policy artifact without adding the separately governed verificationPolicyHash binding to an Attestation, Token, or Credential.
$comment: Derived from README.md#protocol-objects and protocol/applications/economics/policy-layer.md#hashing. policyId is the RFC 8785 plus SHA-256 content address of rules. The rule vocabulary remains profile-defined, while every policy carries a non-empty rule object whose exact bytes are hash-bound.

policyVersion.description: Version label for the policy. Any rule change produces a different policyId.

effectiveFrom.description: Earliest instant at which an issuer may cite this policy version.

previousPolicyId.description: Content address of the immediately preceding policy version, or null for the first version.

rules.description: Non-empty profile-defined verification rules. Every property and value participates in policyId.
